These are the best headbands I have purchased, ever. That is no exaggeration. I easily get headaches from headbands that are too tight, so I was unsure how these would do. After reading others reviews I took the chance, and I am so glad I did. They are awesome quality, the colors are exactly as pictured and the pearl headbands are not glued on as others are. They are not too tight at all! I have worn every headband and never once got a headache from them! I would highly recommend!!

I am obsessed with headbands of any kind especially cute trendy ones i can wear with multiple outfits and these specific headbands meet every requirement i had. Would recommend these to anyone great value for such a low cost!!
They are very comfortable, but because of the cloth they slide around a bit.

I LOVE these headbands. The price is great, they look cute, so many different colors and patterns to match so much! I get so many compliments. I was worried may cause a headache but they haven’t and I wear them all day. If I wear my glasses and them it does bother my ears a bit. Would recommend and buy again!

The ones with the pearls can feel bumpy if not positioned just right on my head. I’ve also found that some of the knots on top are not centered and appear a little off to one side or the other. If you suffer from OCD, this might be a problem. Overall, I think it’s a good mixture of colors and prints.
They’re definitely good quality. They are comfortable for adult heads and they do not look cheap. Worth your money.

I always hesitate to order headbands because with my small head they usually don't fit or they pinch so much I cannot stand to wear them. NOT with these! I think these would be great for tweens too!

reviews.t: Finally found a headband I love
reviews.x: I have admired these types of headbands for a while. But every time I order headbands I want to try they never stay or something is just off.  But.....these are perfect!!!! They came on time, colors and fabrics are great. The price was amazing for the amount. Super adorable. So many colors, dress up or down. I love these!!!

I love these headbands. I usually have trouble wearing headbands, as they just slide right out of my hair or they are too tight and give me headaches. These headbands stay in all day and haven't had a headache yet! I found these to be a great purchase, especially for how many headbands you get!

reviews.t: They’re great but you might not get all patterns pictured
reviews.x: These are super cute and I’m excited to wear them, but no joke my fav headband in the whole pack was replaced with a second pink one! Kinda bummed. Obviously I liked the rest of them too but mustard yellow is my favorite color to wear so that really sucks haha

These are so cute and comfortable and the size is perfect.....not to think and not to tight when wearing.  The assortment is fabulous and the price can’t be beat.  Shipping was prompt....I am very pleased.
These are really great quality! Got them for back to school and they are so cute my girl wants to wear a new one every day. Would definitely recommend for price and quality.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the value and low price for the number of headbands included.
Many reviewers say the headbands are comfortable and do not cause headaches, though a few report tightness or headaches.
Several reviewers note quality issues such as off-center knots or knit, short pearls, and minor damage.
Some reviewers mention the headbands slide around or can bother ears when worn with glasses.
A few reviewers note the patterns received may not match what was pictured.
